sections.history: Low mood for 6 weeks, starting a few weeks after delivery: tearful, anhedonia, guilt. Poor sleep even when the baby sleeps; persistent worry. Intrusive, unwanted thoughts of accidentally dropping the baby, which distress her; urge to harm the baby; avoids carrying him on the stairs. Passive thoughts that her family would be better off without her; no plans or intent; protective factor: baby. Previous depression at 19, treated with fluoxetine for a year. Breastfeeding. Partner has had panic attacks recently; advised to see his own GP.
sections.medications_allergies: No regular medications. No known drug allergies.
sections.impression: Moderately severe postnatal depression with intrusive harm-related thoughts (ego-dystonic) and passive suicidal ideation without plan. Family history of possible postpartum psychosis.
sections.plan: Start sertraline 50 mg three times daily (compatible with breastfeeding). Refer to the perinatal mental health team. Inform health visitor. Talking Therapies details given (priority for new parents). Review in 1 week.
sections.safety_netting: If suicidal thoughts worsen or unable to keep herself safe, call NHS 111 (mental health option) or 999. Seek urgent help if confusion or hallucinations.
